scripts.help:
node -e "console.log('Commands:
- npm run build                         # Compile TypeScript to dist/
- npm run crawl:instances               # Discover instances
- npm run crawl:instances:health        # Check instance health and set status in instances
- npm run crawl:channels                # Collect channel list + basic channel metadata
- npm run crawl:channels:health         # Check channels and write errors to channels
- npm run crawl:channels:videos-count   # Fetch videos_count per channel (errors stored per channel)
- npm run crawl:videos                  # Crawl channels with videos_count >= 1 and save video metadata to videos
- npm run crawl:host-pipeline           # Prioritize channel lists -> NULL counts -> videos across hosts
- npm run crawl:videos:tags             # Update video tags via /api/v1/videos/:uuid
- npm run crawl:videos:comments         # Update comments_count via /api/v1/videos/:uuid
- npm run crawl:videos:thumbnails       # Refresh REST thumbnail candidates; --resume selects SQL NULL rows, batch with --hosts-file
- npm run build-ann-index               # Build FAISS ANN index from server DB
- npm run test:live:thumbnails           # Opt-in live crawler thumbnail contract smoke

Tip: pass flags after --, e.g. npm run crawl:channels -- --help');"
scripts.build: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp schema.sql dist/
scripts.test:db: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && cp schema.sql dist-test/ && node --test dist-test/test/*.test.js dist-test/test/db/*.test.js dist-test/test/live/*.unit.test.js
scripts.test:live:thumbnails: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && cp schema.sql dist-test/ && node dist-test/test/live/thumbnail-contract-smoke.js
